change: Declared model/prefab source accumulation now preflights the existing package payload ceiling of 64 MiB and 4096 distinct source IDs before retaining another imported input group. Shared IDs count once; conflicting revisions or failed reads reject the entire group without changing previously captured state. Native input payload Arcs are retained without copying during accumulation.
verified: Repeated shared source observations do not consume additional quota or replace original payload allocation
Count or byte overflow rejects whole group without partial retention
Conflicting captured bytes reject without changing earlier accepted set
Failed read after successful input does not partially retain the successful input
limits: Bounds retained deferred-source payloads, not complete exporter heap, decoded model output, process RSS or physical GPU memory
One import may allocate its original bounded decode/input state before aggregate admission
Required-scene sources and final serialization retain their existing separate validation paths
No new GPU/window/FPS or native device audio qualification
